name: @spark-match/backend
description: Spark Match backend - serverless DDD+EDA on AWS Lambda with TypeScript (Node.js)

scripts.test:db: npm run migrate:up && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mts
scripts.migrate:create: node-pg-migrate create --migrations-dir 'migrations' --migration-file-language sql --migrations-table spark_match_migrations --migrations-schema public --schema public -- --helper false
scripts.migrate:up: node-pg-migrate up --migrations-dir 'migrations' --migration-file-language sql --migrations-table spark_match_migrations --migrations-schema public --schema public
scripts.migrate:down: node-pg-migrate down --migrations-dir 'migrations' --migration-file-language sql --migrations-table spark_match_migrations --migrations-schema public --schema public
scripts.migrate:redo: node-pg-migrate redo --migrations-dir 'migrations' --migration-file-language sql --migrations-table spark_match_migrations --migrations-schema public --schema public
scripts.migrate:status: node-pg-migrate status --migrations-dir 'migrations' --migration-file-language sql --migrations-table spark_match_migrations --migrations-schema public --schema public
